entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Fedora Linux Dotnet 10 still not available #52253
  • `dotnet format` command replaces some line endings when comments precede multi-line strings #52249
    Backlog

Closed

  • .NET 10: "dotnet list package --vulnerable --include-transitive" misses vulnerable transitive packages #52245
  • `dotnet restore` fails if solution root directory contains %20 in the file path. #14581
    Backlog
  • NETSDK1138 is calling out `TargetFramework` instead of the effective target framework #14515
    Backlog
  • OutputPath (`-o`) option should ensure trialing slash #45682
    10.0.1xx

PullRequests

Created

  • Remove remaining usage of StyleCop #52255
  • Fix build of multi-targeted test projects #52254
  • Add support for zstd-compressed layer media types in container images #52252
  • Enable error logging in source-build tests #52251
    Branch Lockdown
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 140: Build ID 2863984 #52248
  • [release/10.0.2xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #52247

Merged

  • [wasm] Remove _UsingBlazorOrWasmSdk condition from browser-wasm workload detection #52250
    Area-WasmSdk, 11.0.1xx
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #52246
  • Completion #52137
  • Add trailing slash for -o Fixes #45682 #48640
    untriaged, Area-CLI

Updated

    Area-AspNetCore
  • Use RazorLangVersion 10 in .NET 10.0.2xx #52227

  • Publish SDK installer artifacts in CI pipeline #52233
  • Add support for IfDifferent #51826
    Area-NetSDK, Area-AspNetCore

    DO NOT MERGE, PublishVsBuild, Area-NativeAOT, Area-Trimming

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.2xx' #52022
